fields.why:
Change Description
Implement an S-ramp acceleration profile on the drive system to replace the existing linear acceleration ramp during motor start-up.

Background
During equipment start-up, the current acceleration profile can create a noticeable jerking action as torque is applied to the drive system. This sudden change in acceleration places additional mechanical stress on the gearbox, couplings, drive train components, and associated mechanical equipment.
Feedback and review of the current operating characteristics indicate that introducing an S-ramp acceleration profile would provide a smoother transition from standstill to operating speed by gradually increasing and decreasing the rate of acceleration.
fields.design:
The proposed S-ramp profile is intended to:
- Reduce the jerking effect experienced during start-up.
- Minimise shock loading on the gearbox and drive train components.
- Lower mechanical stresses transmitted through couplings, shafts, bearings, and associated equipment.
- Reduce wear and tear on mechanical components, potentially extending equipment service life.
- Improve equipment reliability and decrease the likelihood of premature failures caused by repeated mechanical shock.

Provide smoother equipment operation during start-up without impacting normal operating performance
fields.impact: CV-005 will start more smoothly; no change to how CROs operate the conveyor.
